title: Proof (beauty): 3× hook rate, and the hook audit anyone can copy
hook: A skincare brand tripled its hook rate. We never touched the budget.
caption:
A skincare brand tripled its hook rate. We never touched the budget.
The result is published. The first step of the method is something you can run this week without us.

The numbers for this clean skincare and serum D2C brand (anonymised, on galvor.ai): 3× hook rate, +112% RoAS and 30% less wasted spend.

One brand's numbers will not be yours. The method travels.

The slides show a hook audit for your own account: sort your last 20 ads by how they open, compare hook rate by group, and brief the next batch from what you find.

Every ad should make the next one better.

slides.sub: We work on what goes into the ads. The media budget stays with the brand.

slides.headline: Sort your last 20 ads by *how they open*
Compare *hook rate* by group
slides.body:
Hook rate is three-second views divided by impressions.

Work it out for each group, not each ad. One ad can be a fluke. A group of five that all hold attention is a pattern you can brief from.

slides.headline: Brief the next batch from the *pattern*
slides.body:
Make most of the next batch open the way your strongest group does.

Keep one or two ads for an opening you have never tried, so the audit has something new to read in a fortnight.
